_doc: SEED-ADMIT-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-21: 'for any seed based on the ultrastable platform, the system actually has to build and deploy it and make it fully autonomous with a design goal of being completely unsupervised and unattended for a minimum of 1 year'). The autonomy kit every seed carries, as data. Each component names the files a system must hold, the probe (a command run in the system's own root, exit 0 = works) and the year-simulation faults it answers (`covers`). Read by scripts/seedadmit.py (portable: a system re-admits itself on its own clock) and by foundation/seedadmit.py (core: the launch gate). A seed counts as launched only when every component is present and probes green AND the year simulation, run on the seed's own recovery code, reaches target_days at the 10th percentile in normal and strict mode with every drill exercised. Nothing here names a tenant: a seed adds faults and probes of its own in autonomy/yearsim.json and autonomy/failure-modes.json, never by editing core. No new credential: every route is the repository's built-in token and the existing GitHub App.

components.what: the year simulation and its drills (13 replayed months of injected failure, seeded Monte Carlo)
the probed failure-mode register the tick Worker runs itself; a red probe files its own repair item
every open PR and issue inside its service level; stuck loops filed, stale claims released
a green PR merges within minutes, a conflicting one is reconciled with main
a dead site is noticed and redeployed; a silent scheduler is replaced by the next host
AI allowance and spend stay inside the stated budget; a spike degrades, never halts
per-day series of change per area and loop; hotspots, neglect and drift read before they hurt
probe: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts'); import trajectory; assert callable(trajectory.analyze)

components.what: the system builds and deploys itself from its repository on every push, on the server
weekly re-admission (the year simulation re-run on the seed's own code) and daily drift read, on the built-in token
